question.text: Section 194 TDS on dividends paid by Indian companies to Cat III AIFs is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 9.3.2, Indian companies deduct 10% TDS on dividends to resident shareholders including Cat III AIFs, if aggregate > Rs. 5,000/year. The Trap: Other rates not applicable for resident shareholders post-2020. Cross-Exam Context: Standard TDS on dividend. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Track TDS credits in fund books for investor-level accounting.
